body: As my carpool partner left without informing me, I noticed something out of place—the window was slightly cracked open on his side of the car. A chill ran up my spine as an unpleasant feeling crept into my gut. My impulse had been too strong—it wasn't just about being angry at him for leaving me behind but also about not wanting anyone else to know what was happening inside this closed space. I hesitated before deciding whether or not to take action.
